intro: Morndo wrote these from this morning's work. They sit in your mail as drafts. Nothing is sent until you send it.

items.subject: Week 47: what moved and what needs you
items.body: Search now brings leads at €80, LinkedIn at €200. Sequence A is done, B is ready to start. The webinar is on Thursday and the promo goes out today.

items.subject: Pipeline note for November
items.body: 20 sales calls in the last 14 days, 10 a week. One budget change is waiting for approval that could lift this to 14 a week.

items.subject: Re: your quote in our customer story
items.body: Thank you for signing off the quote. Here is the final text. We plan to publish on Wednesday if the last number is confirmed.

items.subject: Re: can I get the slides afterwards?
items.body: Yes. Everyone who signs up gets the recording and the slides on Friday morning.

items.subject: The partner offer for Halden Freight Network
items.body: Here is the offer from our call on 13 November. Two pages, from the partner template. It stays in your mail until you send it.

items.subject: Two times to talk this week
items.body: Two invite drafts, with the meeting times left open. Jonas asked for two times. Nothing is sent until you send it.

items.subject: The webinar is tomorrow
items.body: A short reminder, about 90 words, with one link to the session. It is scheduled and waits in your mail.
